title: near-miss field name (typo)
notes: One character from 'description' and the message is identical to E-SCHEMA-001. No 'did you mean'. Highest-value Fix win in the taxonomy. Location 1 -> 2 (phase-3 item 7): `  in descrption` is rendered and `prog.pdl:1` is that key's own mark. The path adds least here of anywhere in the corpus -- the key is at the top level, so it is a single segment that repeats the name already in the message. It is rendered anyway, because a renderer that suppressed one-segment paths would make the presence of the line carry meaning of its own.
